notes: Read SKILL.md in full; it is the only file. Hardening checklist for OpenClaw deployments: CI security gates (dependency/image/secret scans, SBOM, signing), container runtime restrictions, production promotion gates, data/session protection, post-deploy verification and a rollback pattern.

The example CI order runs `npm ci`, Trivy scans, Syft SBOM generation into sbom.json and `cosign sign --key cosign.key` against the user's registry image (SKILL.md:28-35). Post-deploy checks are read-only kubectl get/auth can-i/logs commands (SKILL.md:79-82). Medium because it installs dependencies and signs/pushes signatures with the user's signing key; acceptable because these are the user's own pipeline steps, and the guidance otherwise strengthens security.

Related Skills links (SKILL.md:104-106: ../container-hardening/, ../kubernetes-hardening/, ../../scanning/sbom-supply-chain/) are optional pointers that do not ship with this skill. Reading pod logs may surface sensitive data; the skill itself tells the user to verify no plaintext secrets appear. Frontmatter declares license: MIT.
